newsitem.title: UK: UK shares end higher as bid speculation returns.
newsitem.headline: UK shares end higher as bid speculation returns.

text.p: UK shares finished higher for the first time in seven sessions on Thursday as renewed bid speculation swirled around the dealing rooms in London's "Square Mile" financial district.
A firmer look to Wall Street also gave the market a much needed boost, dealers said.
"Talk of predators on the prowl pushed the market up today," one senior dealer said. "The stories going around are old but the old ones are sometimes the best ones."
The FTSE 100, which had dropped in the previous six trading days, ended 19.1 points higher to 4,576.2.
